conversation.Statement: Good morning, this is Officer Daniel Evans from the IRS Enforcement Division, badge number 45721. Can you confirm your full name and business address for our records?
Uh, yeah, this is Jamie Cooper. My business address is just my apartment, I work from home. Did I do something wrong?
Jamie, I'm contacting you about your 2023 federal tax filings. We have identified a failure to submit proper 1099 forms for contract income, which is a serious violation.
Wait, I thought I used the online portal correctly. I freelance, but I don't have employees or anything. Am I in trouble?
You are currently listed as non-compliant with IRS regulations. This could result in financial penalties, an immediate audit, or suspension of your business activity.
Oh, wow. I had no idea. Is there something I can do to fix this?
There is a pending case against your tax ID. If you fail to resolve this, you may face court proceedings and possible criminal charges. Do you understand the seriousness?
I'm really scared. I didn't mean to do anything wrong. What exactly am I supposed to do?
To avoid formal charges and business license revocation, you can settle the outstanding balance today. Are you prepared to resolve this matter immediately?
I think so, but how do I know this is real? I've never had to do this before.
This call is being recorded by the IRS. Your case number is 37319-B. Non-compliance will lead to an arrest warrant. To proceed, you must follow my payment instructions exactly.
Ok, I don't want any trouble. What do I need to do?
You are required to make a settlement payment of $2,185 today. This must be completed via Bitcoin to the IRS compliance wallet address I provide. Do you have access to a Bitcoin wallet?
No, I don't. I've never used Bitcoin before. Can I pay some other way?
For urgent cases, Bitcoin is our only accepted method. I will guide you through setting up a wallet and purchasing the cryptocurrency. Are you at your computer right now?
Yeah, I am. I guess I can try. What do I do first?
Go to coinbase.com and register an account. Once you are logged in, let me know. I will provide you with the IRS Bitcoin wallet address for the payment.
I'm signing up now. This is really stressful. Will this make the case go away?
Once payment is confirmed, your account will be marked as compliant, and all penalties and legal actions will be withdrawn. Do not discuss this with anyone, or it could interfere with your case.
Okay. It says I need to link my bank account to buy Bitcoin. Is that safe?

Yes, it is secure. The IRS requires this step for verification. Once you have completed your purchase, I will provide the wallet address: 3FZbgi29cpjq2GjdwV8eyHuJJnkLtktZc5. Notify me once the transfer is complete.
Alright, I'm trying to buy it now. How will I know if you get the payment?
I will receive a confirmation immediately and update your case status. If you fail to complete this in the next 30 minutes, enforcement procedures will begin.
